intro: This page covers JFK’s official lots — the Long-Term Parking Lot, the Terminal 4 Blue, Terminal 5 Yellow, and Terminal 8 Red lots, and the reservation-only Federal Circle Station Lot — with daily rates copied from the airport’s parking page on November 18, 2026. Below that are eight off-airport options whose addresses, hours, and shuttle facts come from each operator’s own site, including two lots the airport lists as authorized off-airport providers. Rates here are dated snapshots, not live quotes.

officialLots.name: Long-Term Parking Lot
officialLots.area: On-airport; AirTrain to the terminals from this lot. The airport’s FAQs say long-term parking is near Lefferts Boulevard Station.

hours.notes: Daily opening hours were not listed on the official parking page checked November 18, 2026.

officialLots.rateNotes: The official table is labeled “Drive-Up Rate” and “Prebook Rate (Book At Least 3 Hours in Advance).”
officialLots.visitNotes: The airport says you can take AirTrain to the terminals from this lot. Vehicles parked more than 30 days must be registered with ABM Parking or may be treated as abandoned.

officialLots.name: Terminal 4 Blue Lot
officialLots.access: The airport’s FAQs say each terminal station is next to its short-term parking lot.

hours.notes: Daily opening hours were not listed on the official parking page checked November 18, 2026.

officialLots.hourlyOrIncrement: Drive-up: $6 for 1/2 hour; $12 for each additional half hour or fraction thereof (over a three-hour stay)
officialLots.rateNotes: The official table is labeled “Drive-Up Rate” and “Prebook Rate (Book At Least 3 Hours in Advance).”
officialLots.visitNotes: The airport says parking availability is reduced during construction, and that prebook discounts are also available in the adjacent Red Garage. Restricted-mobility parkers with a valid ADA placard or tag do not need to prebook.

officialLots.name: Terminal 5 Yellow Lot
officialLots.access: The airport’s FAQs say each terminal station is next to its short-term parking lot.

hours.notes: Daily opening hours were not listed on the official parking page checked November 18, 2026.

officialLots.hourlyOrIncrement: Drive-up: $6 for 1/2 hour; $12 for each additional half hour or fraction thereof (over a three-hour stay)
officialLots.rateNotes: The official table is labeled “Drive-Up Rate” and “Prebook Rate (Book At Least 3 Hours in Advance).” The airport also says Level 2 ChargePoint charging in this lot is free, but you must still pay to enter the lot.
officialLots.heightRestriction: Level 1 (surface under garage): 8'2"; levels 2 and above: 7'6"
officialLots.visitNotes: Level 2 ChargePoint chargers are in this lot, according to the official parking page.

officialLots.name: Terminal 8 Red Lot
officialLots.access: The airport’s FAQs say each terminal station is next to its short-term parking lot.

hours.notes: Daily opening hours were not listed on the official parking page checked November 18, 2026.

officialLots.hourlyOrIncrement: Drive-up: $6 for 1/2 hour; $12 for each additional half hour or fraction thereof (over a three-hour stay)
officialLots.rateNotes: The official table is labeled “Drive-Up Rate” and “Prebook Rate (Book At Least 3 Hours in Advance).”
officialLots.heightRestriction: Level 1 (surface under garage): 8'2"; levels 2 and above: 7'6"
officialLots.visitNotes: The airport recommends this lot if you are using Terminal 1.

officialLots.name: Federal Circle Station Lot

hours.notes: Daily opening hours were not listed on the official parking page checked November 18, 2026.

officialLots.rateNotes: The official table lists the drive-up 24-hour maximum as N/A. Prebook requires a reservation at least 3 hours in advance.
officialLots.visitNotes: Available by reservation only, subject to availability. The airport says no ADA discounts are available at this lot, and the path to AirTrain is uncovered.

listings.name: SmartPark JFK
listings.address: 123-10 South Conduit Ave., South Ozone Park, NY 11420

hours.notes: The operator says it serves JFK 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.

listings.shuttle: The operator’s FAQ says shuttles leave for the airport terminals every few minutes and drop you at the departure level of your airline. The trip is described as about 7 minutes; the lot is about 1.5 miles from the terminal. On return, call (877) 535-PARK after you have your luggage.
listings.offersNotes: The operator says it is officially licensed by the New York City Department of Consumer Affairs and a certified vendor of the Port Authority of NY/NJ. JFK’s official parking page lists SmartPark JFK as an authorized off-airport option.
listings.visitNotes: Payment is made when you return for the vehicle, according to the FAQ. Standard reservations do not require a credit card, the operator says.
listings.feeNotes: Rate as listed on November 18, 2026: $27.99 per day, plus a 10.375% New York City parking tax and a 6.625% Airport Use Recovery Fee. Rates are calculated on a 24-hour day from check-in. Confirm the price when you book; this is not a live quote.

listings.name: JFK Long Term Parking Inc. (AirPark JFK)
listings.address: 122-02 South Conduit Ave, South Ozone Park, NY 11420

hours.notes: The operator’s site says “Open 24/7 365 Days a Year.”

listings.shuttle: The operator says complimentary shuttle service operates around the clock between the facility and the airport terminals, with luggage assistance on request. The FAQ says shuttles run continuously, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year, and that the lot is about 5 minutes from the terminals.
listings.offersNotes: The operator’s homepage says “Airpark Kennedy Is Now Located at JFK Longterm Parking.” JFK’s official parking page lists “AirPark JFK/JFK Long-Term Parking Inc.” as an authorized off-airport option and links to this operator. The official table shows a different phone number, +1 (718) 898-8400; the operator’s JFK listing uses (718) 843-8400, which is the number published on its own site.
listings.visitNotes: The operator says reservations can be made without a credit card, and that the lot is licensed by the Port Authority of NY & NJ.
listings.feeNotes: Rate as listed on November 18, 2026: $18.95/plus tax for Kennedy (JFK). Confirm the price when you book; this is not a live quote.

listings.name: Safe Park JFK

hours.notes: The operator’s hours table lists 12:00 am–11:45 pm each day. The same homepage also says “Open 24/7.”

listings.shuttle: The operator’s homepage advertises “24/7 Free Valet and shuttle service.” Shuttle frequency was not published on the pages we checked.
listings.offersNotes: The operator says one day is the minimum stay, and that a $5 fee is added for oversized vehicles.
listings.visitNotes: The operator warns of heavier traffic because of ongoing construction at JFK and asks travelers to allow extra time. This lot is not on the airport’s authorized off-airport table.
listings.feeNotes: Rate as listed on November 18, 2026: $27.95/day + tax, with every 7th day free as advertised on the homepage. Confirm the price when you book; this is not a live quote.

listings.name: FlyPark JFK (The Parking Point)

hours.notes: The operator says the lot is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including holidays.

listings.shuttle: The operator says a free round-trip shuttle runs 24 hours a day. Pickup frequency was not published on the operator’s own homepage we checked.
offers: Pay later at the lot or online
listings.offersNotes: The operator says free valet is included with every reservation, and that no upfront payment is required to reserve.
listings.visitNotes: This lot is not on the airport’s authorized off-airport table. A second phone number, +1 (347) 960-7095, also appears on the operator’s site.
listings.feeNotes: The homepage advertised a “$12.99 starting daily rate” when checked on November 18, 2026. That is a starting figure, not a live quote for your dates. Confirm the price when you book.

listings.name: Prime Park JFK
listings.address: 15115 Lefferts Blvd, South Ozone Park, NY 11420

hours.notes: The operator says the facility is monitored 24/7. Daily opening hours were not published as a 24-hour schedule on the page we checked.

listings.shuttle: The operator says complimentary shuttle service to and from JFK is included for all customers. Frequency and late-night rules were not published on the page we checked.
listings.visitNotes: This lot is not on the airport’s authorized off-airport table.
listings.feeNotes: The operator says it offers competitive short-term and long-term rates but did not publish a single daily figure on the JFK page we checked. Confirm pricing on the operator’s site when you book.

listings.name: ARB Parking JFK
listings.address: 128-20 152nd Ave, South Ozone Park, NY 11420, USA

hours.notes: The JFK FAQ says ARB Parking operates 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. The homepage also advertises 24/7 availability.

listings.shuttle: The operator advertises a 24/7 free shuttle. The JFK FAQ says the trip usually takes about 5 minutes, that shuttles leave every few minutes, and that they drop you at the departure level of your airline. On return, call 718-480-6663 after you have your luggage. A second phone number, (718) 480-6664, is also listed on the homepage.
listings.visitNotes: The FAQ says payment is made at check-in, and that a 3-hour grace period after the 24-hour day applies only to reservations made directly with ARB Parking. This lot is not on the airport’s authorized off-airport table.
listings.feeNotes: The operator advertises a lowest-price guarantee but did not publish a single daily figure on the pages we checked. Confirm pricing on the operator’s site when you book.

listings.name: Courtyard by Marriott New York JFK Airport
listings.address: 145-11 North Conduit Avenue, Jamaica, New York, USA, 11436

hours.notes: The hotel lists a gated lot with 24-hour in/out privileges for valet parking. A separate 24-hour public lot schedule was not published.

listings.shuttle: The hotel’s official page says a complimentary 24-hour JFK shuttle is available. To reserve a spot, it says to call 718-848-2121 or use https://trackmyshuttle.com/a/2121/q. The hotel is listed as 0.5 miles from JFK.
listings.offersNotes: The official hotel page describes Park & Fly as: “Book a one-night hotel stay and receive five consecutive days of secure parking.” Regular valet is also listed separately.
listings.visitNotes: The hotel says valet parking is very limited. This is a hotel package, not a standalone parking lot. The official page also says the hotel does not have EV charging stations.
listings.feeNotes: Regular valet as listed on November 18, 2026: $50.00 per day. The Park & Fly package terms quoted above do not include a separate cash price on that overview page. Confirm current package and valet prices when you book; these are not live quotes.

sources.label: Official Courtyard New York JFK Airport page

listings.name: Marriott New York JFK Airport

hours.notes: The property lists 24-hour services. A separate daily parking-lot hours schedule was not published on the overview page we checked.

listings.shuttle: The official page says the complimentary airport shuttle from the hotel runs every 30 minutes on the top and bottom of the hour, with no reservation needed. From the airport, it says to take AirTrain to Federal Circle and request pickup at TrackMyShuttle.com/2552. The hotel is listed as 0.5 miles from JFK.
listings.offersNotes: The official overview mentions a “convenient Park N Fly package” but does not spell out how many parking days are included. We did not invent those terms.
listings.visitNotes: This is a hotel package, not a standalone parking lot. The official page says the hotel does not have EV charging and does not allow pets (service animals only).
listings.feeNotes: Valet as listed on November 18, 2026: $55.00 per day; oversized vehicles $65.00 per day. Confirm current valet and Park N Fly prices when you book; these are not live quotes.
